items.title: Dell Technologies (DELL) Will Build An Alabama Research Computing Center
items.summary: Dell Technologies (NYSE:DELL) and the University of Alabama announced a new high performance computing center for statewide research collaboration. The facility will integrate Dell infrastructure with NVIDIA AI systems to support data intensive projects across Alabama's academic community. Federal funding is involved in the build out, tying the project to broader public research and education priorities.
